confidence_notes: Beer and meal anchors rest on crowdsourced Numbeo and Mylifeelsewhere averages of unknown date. Cocktail and wine are derived from the local beer price because I found no direct Mumbai cocktail or wine data. Hostel and hotel anchors come from undated aggregator averages that disagree widely, so accommodation is the least certain. The FX value is the latest RBA observation I could find (20 March 2026), not a confirmed value for the generation date. Rupee conversions assume about 90 INR per USD.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city basis was used; anchors are Mumbai-specific. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the local draft beer anchor. The private hostel room was set at about 2.5 times the dorm bed.
